implement_proposer_subclass: implement a subclass of BaseProposer that overrides the propose method to return a new World and log probability tensor
override_propose_method: override the propose method in a BaseProposer subclass to generate candidate worlds given a World input
customize_adaptation: customize the do_adaptation method in a BaseProposer subclass to update internal state based on acceptance log probability

review_base_proposer_interface: review the BaseProposer abstract class and its propose, do_adaptation, and finish_adaptation method signatures
